title: Unified Production Gate: Ship-Readiness for 4 Flagship Pillars
brief: Single production gate that consumes outputs of EIGC, MXU, and ACP tracks. Validates: all 4 flagship pillars pass golden-path E2E, support matrix is truthful, automation chains are stable, memory/continuity is reliable, and cross-pillar workflows complete without degraded-but-hidden failures. Replaces the 3 separate gate milestones (EIGC-MS11, MXU-MS11, ACP-MS8) to prevent contradictory gate checks.

units.title: Verify EIGC support matrix is complete and truthful
Verify MXU activation matrix — >=90% product-critical engines active
Verify ACP automation chains fire, downgrade cleanly, and survive compaction
Verify production governance: lint, build, tests, audit scripts all pass
Lock release gate matrix and production governance checklist

exit_conditions: All 4 flagship pillars pass golden-path E2E
Support matrix truthful — no overclaimed capabilities
Cross-pillar workflow completes without hidden degradation
notes: Unified gate replacing EIGC-MS11, MXU-MS11, ACP-MS8 to prevent contradictory gate checks
